object_description: balanced volumetric composition around a patio and cascading stair
design_condition: The project leaves the park weakly characterized and places large glazed facades directly on grass without resolving their relationship to the ground.

positive.statement: The program has a very good layout associated with high-quality spaces.

position.rationale: The balanced footprint and repeated levels anchor the overall program organization.

positive.statement: The volumetric composition is balanced and harmonious.

position.rationale: Parallel volumes and stepped massing are clearly legible across the calibrated views.

positive.statement: The spaces are well ordered and dimensioned through the distributive system.

position.rationale: A central internal anchor approximates the circulation system within the patio-centered mass.

positive.statement: The overall architectural expression and natural-lighting qualities are convincing.

position.rationale: Upper facade surfaces and roof openings provide the strongest sampled light-expression evidence.

negative.statement: The project lacks a structural order capable of organizing the interior in line with the tectonic character of the facades.

position.rationale: The outer facade surface is visible, while its interior structural order remains unresolved.

negative.statement: The interior structure appears randomly arranged, with often undersized posts in unexpected places.

position.rationale: A representative internal point locates the criticized post arrangement without visible identification.

negative.statement: The relationship of the facades to the ground is unresolved, with large glazings placed seamlessly on grass.

position.rationale: Low facade edges meet the sampled ground plane along the building perimeter.

negative.statement: Independent access for the aula and gymnasium remains unresolved.

position.rationale: A perimeter ground-level anchor represents unresolved independent access.

negative.statement: The distribution of technical ducts appears not to have been considered, leaving no margin for this fundamental aspect during execution.

position.rationale: Technical distribution is an operational execution issue without a useful sampled exterior marker.

negative.statement: The solar-protection system is undersized and inadequate.

position.rationale: An upper facade location approximates the daylight-control system.

negative.statement: These unresolved points make the project fragile in its capacity to withstand the execution process.

position.rationale: The statement evaluates overall execution robustness rather than a specific geometric location.

negative.statement: The park project has not gained enough substance to characterize it within the sequence of existing or future public spaces.

position.rationale: A peripheral ground anchor represents the weakly characterized park context.
